implementation_strategy: Use the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 execution harness with one shared initial generation per task (shared_initial_candidate), deterministic vendor-canonicalization and sanitization, Batfish-based deterministic validator in sandbox scenarios, and a bounded repair loop of at most one repair call per task in the guarded condition. All steps, prompts, seeds, and validator outputs recorded in execution manifest. No human scoring or adjudication.
task_manifest_strategy: Select 200 distinct tasks from CNSM2026-GenVal-Batfish-task-corpus-v1, balanced across 4 strata (50 per stratum: IOS-like single-step, IOS-like multi-step, JunOS-like single-step, JunOS-like multi-step). Exclude tasks mapping to unsupported Batfish features prior to execution.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic vendor-syntax canonicalizer, AST-based serializer/deserializer, and regex sanitization applied to every generated config prior to Batfish ingestion; round-trip parse and AST-diff checks enforced automatically.
execution_batches: batch_1: 200 paired tasks (all tasks executed under both conditions, balanced across 4 strata)
randomisation_plan: Deterministic balanced sampling with fixed seed 42 for task selection and stratum assignment; assignment and seed recorded immutably in execution manifest.
caching_plan: Per-task response and validator-output caching for reproducibility; no cached responses used to alter selection. Cached items hashed and recorded.
failure_recovery_plan: No additional model-call retries beyond adapter limits. Transient infrastructure/API failures recorded as technical failures and handled per missingness_plan: affected pairs excluded from primary complete-pair analysis; sensitivity analysis treats guarded-arm failures as validator-detected errors.
result_schema: Per-task paired binary episode: final artifact validator outcome (validator-detected error = 1; validator-clean = 0) plus metadata (task_id, stratum, prompts, model_response_hashes, validator_logs).
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated 400 hosted-model API calls (one shared initial generation per task, plus up to one guarded repair call per task). Within capability manifest model-call cap (10000) and planned wall-clock budget.
